blurb: East Peak Climbing is a 6,700 square foot indoor climbing gym located in a renovated historic theatre. It features auto belays, top rope climbing, lead climbing, and bouldering with walls up to 50 feet tall. The facility includes a fitness area, member lounge, multi-purpose room, and a gear shop.
extraNote: Sign waiver online before first climb · Memberships have a $7 monthly freeze fee · Only East Peak employees provide instruction in gym
